_premise: A dispatcher is interrupted every four minutes. The board must be re-readable in one glance, at 02:00, on the tenth hour, after a phone call.
_note: Colors are authoritative in OKLCH (see _oklch); the hex below is the exact sRGB round-trip, provided for tooling. Shipped CSS uses oklch() so there are no undeclared hex literals anywhere in the build.

_contrast.--border on --surface: 1.44:1 — hairline rule only, never a state signal

--f-ui: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif
--f-mono: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', 'Roboto Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
--e-2: var(--surface-2) + 1px var(--border-strong) — the one focused panel, and hover
_elevation_rule: Elevation is a lightness step, never a shadow. In a room dimmed for a 10-hour shift a drop shadow is invisible; a 4% lightness step is not. There is no box-shadow anywhere in this build.
_motion_animates: row hover/focus tint (--d-tick); control press (--d-fast, translateY 1px); status token colour change (--d-base) — the one moment; disclosure open via grid-template-rows 0fr->1fr (--d-base, --ease-in-out); live-feed dot opacity (--d-live, infinite); unfilled strip fields on load (--d-unfilled, infinite)
_motion_never: page/section entrances, scroll-triggered anything, numbers counting up, the rack rendering, route changes, anything above 300ms that is not a continuous loop
_motion_reduced: live dot and unfilled pulse hold at a static opacity; disclosure snaps; press and hover keep the colour change, drop the transform
